examGuide.title: Approach the exam question
examGuide.body: Choose IPC based on what is exchanged and what synchronization is needed. Shared memory avoids copying after setup but still needs an explicit synchronization protocol. Pipes and message queues communicate through kernel-managed channels. Distinguish data availability, mutual exclusion and message ordering; solving one does not automatically solve the others.

examGuide.title: Worked problem
examGuide.body:
A producer-consumer buffer holds 12 entries and initially contains 5. What should a counting semaphore tracking empty slots be initialized to?

**Answer: 7.** Empty capacity is total slots minus occupied slots: 12−5=7. A separate full-slot semaphore starts at 5, and a mutual-exclusion semaphore, if used, starts at 1.

examGuide.title: Conditions and edge cases
examGuide.body:
The order of waiting for capacity and acquiring a mutex matters; blocking while holding a lock needed by the other party can deadlock.

Shared memory alone provides visibility of storage, not mutual exclusion or application-level ordering.
